# 2. Database Model

PostgreSQL 17, schema managed by Alembic. Conventions:

* Primary keys are `uuid` (generated by the application). UUIDs are safe to
  create on any node and don't leak record counts.
* Every hotel-owned table has `hotel_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES hotels`, and
  every index that serves a query begins with `hotel_id`.
* Timestamps are `timestamptz` (UTC). **Stay dates are `date`** in the hotel's
  local calendar: a night belongs to a date, not an instant.
* Money is `numeric(14,2)` plus a `char(3)` ISO-4217 currency, never a float.
  Exchange rates are `numeric(18,8)`.
* Mutable aggregates carry `version integer` for optimistic locking, plus
  `created_at`, `updated_at`, `created_by`.
* Translatable content (room type names, descriptions, facility texts) uses a
  `jsonb` **LocalizedText** value `{"en": "...", "fr": "...", "km": "..."}`.
  The UI falls back from the user's language to the hotel's default language,
  then to any available value. One column per translatable field keeps queries
  simple, and validation ensures that only supported language codes are stored.
* Extensions: `btree_gist` (exclusion constraints), `pg_trgm` (fuzzy search),
  `citext` (case-insensitive emails).

## 2.1 Entity map

```
organizations ─┬─< hotels ─┬─< buildings ─< floors
               │           ├─< room_types ─┬─< room_type_amenities >── amenities
               │           │               └─< rooms ─┬─< room_amenities
               │           │                          ├─< room_allocations (ledger, EXCLUDE)
               │           │                          └─< room_blocks
               │           ├─< facilities ─< facility media
               │           ├─< services
               │           ├─< tax_rates, currencies, exchange_rates
               │           ├─< rate_plans ─< daily_rates (room_type × date)
               │           ├─< pricing_rules, cancellation_policies
               │           ├─< guests
               │           ├─< reservations ─┬─< reservation_rooms ─< reservation_nights
               │           │                 ├─< reservation_guests
               │           │                 ├─< folio_charges
               │           │                 ├─< payments
               │           │                 ├─< invoices ─< invoice_lines
               │           │                 └─< reservation_events (history)
               │           ├─< housekeeping_tasks, room_status_history
               │           ├─< maintenance_requests ─< maintenance_comments
               │           ├─< channel_connections ─┬─< channel_room_mappings
               │           │                        ├─< channel_rate_mappings
               │           │                        ├─< channel_inbound_reservations
               │           │                        └─< channel_messages (log)
               │           ├─< document_sequences
               │           └─< notifications
               ├─< users ─┬─< user_hotel_roles >── roles ─< role_permissions
               │          ├─< user_sessions
               │          └─< login_events
               └─< roles
jobs, audit_logs, backup_runs, media_files  (cross-cutting)
```

## 2.2 Tables

### Tenancy and configuration

| Table | Key columns | Constraints and notes |
|-------|-------------|-------------------|
| `organizations` | id, name | Tenant root. |
| `hotels` | id, organization_id, code, name, legal_name, description (LocalizedText), address_line1/2, city, region, postal_code, country_code, latitude, longitude, phone, email, website, social_links jsonb, timezone, default_language, supported_languages text[], currency_code, check_in_time, check_out_time, logo_file_id, cover_file_id, tax_id, billing_info jsonb, policies jsonb (cancellation / payment / house text, LocalizedText), is_active, version | `UNIQUE(organization_id, code)`. |
| `buildings` | id, hotel_id, code, name, sort_order, is_active | `UNIQUE(hotel_id, code)` |
| `floors` | id, hotel_id, building_id, level int, name, sort_order | `UNIQUE(building_id, level)` |
| `amenities` | id, hotel_id, code, name LocalizedText, icon, scope (`room` \| `hotel`), sort_order, is_active | `UNIQUE(hotel_id, code)`; defaults seeded, unlimited custom ones. |
| `room_types` | id, hotel_id, code, name, description (LocalizedText), base_occupancy, max_occupancy, max_adults, max_children, bed_configuration jsonb, size_sqm, base_price, extra_adult_price, extra_child_price, color, sort_order, is_active, version | `UNIQUE(hotel_id, code)`; `CHECK(max_occupancy >= base_occupancy)`. The UI calls these **room categories**; unlimited. |
| `rooms` | id, hotel_id, room_type_id, building_id, floor_id, number, name, max_occupancy (override), bed_configuration (override), size_sqm, bathroom, has_balcony, view, base_price (override), housekeeping_status, notes, sort_order, is_active, version | `UNIQUE(hotel_id, number)`. Deactivating a room removes it from sale but keeps its history. |
| `room_type_amenities`, `room_amenities` | (parent_id, amenity_id) | composite PK |
| `facilities` | id, hotel_id, code, name, description (LocalizedText), category, opening_hours jsonb, is_available, pricing_mode, price, conditions LocalizedText, notes, sort_order, is_active | Pool, spa, restaurant… |
| `services` | id, hotel_id, code, name, description, facility_id NULL, price, pricing_unit (`per_item` \| `per_night` \| `per_person` \| `per_person_night` \| `per_stay`), tax_group, is_active | Sellable extras, independent of room categories. |
| `media_files` | id, hotel_id, owner_type, owner_id, kind, filename, content_type, size, sha256, storage_key, sort_order | Files are stored on disk under a random key; the type is checked by its magic bytes, not the file extension. |

### Taxes and currency

| Table | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `tax_rates` | id, hotel_id, code, name, kind (`percent` \| `fixed_per_night` \| `fixed_per_person_night`), rate, is_inclusive, applies_to (`accommodation` \| `services` \| `all`), compound_order, valid_from, valid_to, is_active |
| `hotel_currencies` | (hotel_id, currency_code), is_enabled. The base currency is `hotels.currency_code`. |
| `exchange_rates` | id, hotel_id, currency_code, rate_to_base numeric(18,8), effective_at, source, created_by. Append-only; a payment records the rate it used. |

### Inventory and reservations (the integrity core)

| Table | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `guests` | id, hotel_id, first_name, last_name, email citext, phone, phone_normalized, nationality, preferred_language, address…, date_of_birth, vip_level, tags text[], preferences jsonb, notes, id_document_type, id_document_number (encrypted bytea), id_document_country, id_document_expiry, marketing_consent, merged_into_id, version. Indexes: `gin (lower(last_name||' '||first_name) gin_trgm_ops)`, `(hotel_id, lower(email))`, `(hotel_id, phone_normalized)`. |
| `reservations` | id, hotel_id, code, booker_guest_id, status (`pending` \| `confirmed` \| `checked_in` \| `checked_out` \| `cancelled` \| `no_show`), source (`direct` \| `website` \| `booking_com` \| `agoda` \| `walk_in` \| `phone` \| `email` \| `other`), channel_connection_id, external_ref, arrival, departure, adults, children, currency, totals (accommodation, services, discount, tax, grand_total, paid, balance), is_overbooked, special_requests, internal_notes, cancelled_at, cancellation_reason, version. `UNIQUE(hotel_id, code)`, `UNIQUE(channel_connection_id, external_ref)`. |
| `reservation_rooms` | id, hotel_id, reservation_id, room_type_id, room_id NULL, rate_plan_id, arrival, departure, `stay daterange GENERATED ALWAYS AS (daterange(arrival, departure, '[)')) STORED`, adults, children, status, occupies_inventory bool, checked_in_at, checked_out_at. `CHECK(departure > arrival)`. GiST index on `(room_type_id, stay)`. |
| `reservation_nights` | (reservation_room_id, date), price, rate_plan_id, price_source. The nightly price is **fixed at booking time** and later rate changes don't reprice existing bookings. Basis for ADR/RevPAR. |
| `room_blocks` | id, hotel_id, room_id, start_date, end_date, reason (`maintenance` \| `out_of_service` \| `owner_use` \| `other`), maintenance_request_id, notes |
| **`room_allocations`** | id, hotel_id, room_id, `period daterange`, reservation_room_id UNIQUE NULL, room_block_id UNIQUE NULL, `CHECK (num_nonnulls(reservation_room_id, room_block_id) = 1)`, **`EXCLUDE USING gist (room_id WITH =, period WITH &&)`**. Maintained only by triggers on `reservation_rooms` and `room_blocks`. **This single constraint is what makes double-allocation physically impossible.** |
| `reservation_events` | id, hotel_id, reservation_id, at, user_id, source, action, diff jsonb. A complete modification history; the "Modified" badge is derived from it. |

**Status vs. "Modified".** `Modified` is not a lifecycle state: a confirmed
booking whose dates change is still confirmed. Modifications are recorded in
`reservation_events`, and the UI shows a *Modified* badge when any exist. This
keeps the lifecycle state machine unambiguous:

```
pending ──▶ confirmed ──▶ checked_in ──▶ checked_out
   │            │
   ├────────────┴──▶ cancelled
   └────────────────▶ no_show   (from confirmed too, after arrival date)
```

**Availability formula** for room type *T* on night *n*:

```
available(T, n) = |active rooms of type T not in room_allocations covering n|
                − |reservation_rooms of type T, unassigned, occupying, covering n|
```

### Pricing

| Table | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `rate_plans` | id, hotel_id, code, name, meal_plan (`room_only` \| `breakfast` \| `half_board` \| `full_board` \| `all_inclusive`), cancellation_policy_id, is_refundable, parent_rate_plan_id, derive_mode (`percent` \| `amount`), derive_value, is_active |
| `daily_rates` | (rate_plan_id, room_type_id, date) PK, hotel_id, price NULL, min_stay, max_stay, closed, closed_to_arrival, closed_to_departure. The ARI grid edited by the pricing calendar. |
| `pricing_rules` | id, hotel_id, kind (`season` \| `weekday` \| `long_stay` \| `last_minute` \| `early_bird` \| `occupancy`), priority, date_from, date_to, weekdays smallint[], room_type_ids, rate_plan_ids, adjustment (`percent` \| `amount` \| `set`), value, conditions jsonb, is_active |
| `cancellation_policies` | id, hotel_id, name, rules jsonb `[{"days_before": 7, "penalty": "percent", "value": 50}]`, no_show_penalty |

**Price resolution** for (room type, rate plan, night):
`daily_rates.price` if set → otherwise the room type's `base_price` (or the
parent plan's price for derived plans) → then the applicable `pricing_rules`
in priority order → then occupancy supplements (extra adult/child). Discounts
and taxes are applied by `pricing.quote()`, the **only** price calculator in
the system; reservations, the front desk and channel pushes all call it.

### Billing

| Table | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `folio_charges` | id, hotel_id, reservation_id, reservation_room_id, kind (`accommodation` \| `service` \| `fee` \| `discount` \| `adjustment`), service_id, description, service_date, quantity, unit_price, amount, currency, tax_breakdown jsonb, is_void, void_reason, created_by |
| `payments` | id, hotel_id, reservation_id, guest_id, kind (`payment` \| `deposit` \| `refund`), method (`cash` \| `card` \| `bank_transfer` \| `online` \| `other`), amount, currency, exchange_rate, amount_base, reference, card_brand, card_last4, received_at, received_by, is_void, void_reason. **No full card number, CVV or track data is ever stored.** |
| `invoices` | id, hotel_id, number, series, reservation_id, status (`draft` \| `issued` \| `void`), issue_date, language, currency, billed_to jsonb (snapshot), hotel_snapshot jsonb, subtotal, tax_total, total, pdf_file_id |
| `invoice_lines` | invoice_id, position, description, quantity, unit_price, tax_breakdown, amount |
| `document_sequences` | (hotel_id, kind, series) PK, prefix, next_value. Incremented with `SELECT … FOR UPDATE`, so invoice numbers are **gapless**. |

### Operations

| Table | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `housekeeping_tasks` | id, hotel_id, room_id, task_date, task_type, priority, status (`pending` \| `in_progress` \| `done` \| `inspected` \| `skipped`), assigned_to, started_at, completed_at, inspected_by, notes |
| `room_status_history` | room_id, from_status, to_status, changed_by, changed_at |
| `maintenance_requests` | id, hotel_id, room_id NULL, facility_id NULL, title, description, priority, status (`reported` \| `pending` \| `in_progress` \| `completed` \| `cancelled`), assigned_to, reported_by, blocks_room, room_block_id, started_at, completed_at, notes |

The housekeeping status shown in the UI combines the stored cleaning state
(`clean` / `dirty` / `in_progress` / `inspected`) with the derived states
*occupied* (from the allocation ledger), *out of service* (from blocks), and
*maintenance required* (from open requests). Those derived states are computed
from their sources rather than stored again, so they can't drift apart.

### Users and security

| Table | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `users` | id, organization_id, email citext UNIQUE, full_name, password_hash (argon2id), preferred_language, is_active, is_superadmin, totp_secret (encrypted), totp_enabled, failed_logins, locked_until, password_changed_at, last_login_at, version |
| `roles` | id, organization_id, code, name, description, is_system |
| `role_permissions` | (role_id, permission) — permission codes come from the catalog in `core/permissions.py` |
| `user_hotel_roles` | (user_id, hotel_id, role_id) |
| `user_sessions` | id, user_id, token_hash UNIQUE (SHA-256 of a 256-bit random token), created_at, last_seen_at, expires_at, ip, user_agent, device_label, revoked_at, revoked_by, revoke_reason |
| `login_events` | id, user_id NULL, email, success, reason, ip, user_agent, at |
| `audit_logs` | id bigserial, organization_id, hotel_id, user_id, session_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, changes jsonb, ip, request_id, at. A trigger rejects `UPDATE`/`DELETE`, so the log is append-only. |

### Channel manager and jobs

| Table | Notes |
|-------|-------|
| `channel_connections` | id, hotel_id, channel (`booking_com` \| `agoda` \| …), external_hotel_id, status (`not_configured` \| `active` \| `paused` \| `error`), credentials (encrypted bytea), settings jsonb, last_success_at, last_error |
| `channel_room_mappings` | connection_id, room_type_id, external_room_id — `UNIQUE(connection_id, external_room_id)` |
| `channel_rate_mappings` | connection_id, room_type_id, rate_plan_id, external_rate_id, price_adjustment |
| `channel_dirty_ranges` | connection_id, room_type_id, rate_plan_id NULL, date_from, date_to, created_at. Written in the same transaction as the business change; consumed by the ARI sync job. |
| `channel_ari_state` | (connection_id, room_type_id, rate_plan_id, date) PK, availability, price, restrictions jsonb, acknowledged_at. The last values the channel accepted; deltas are computed against it. |
| `channel_inbound_reservations` | connection_id, external_id, revision, payload (raw), status, reservation_id, error, received_at — `UNIQUE(connection_id, external_id, revision)` makes imports idempotent. |
| `channel_messages` | Request/response log (credentials redacted), for diagnostics. |
| `jobs` | id, hotel_id, queue, kind, payload jsonb, dedupe_key, status (`pending` \| `running` \| `succeeded` \| `failed` \| `dead`), attempts, max_attempts, run_after, locked_by, locked_until, last_error, created_at, finished_at. Partial unique index on `dedupe_key WHERE status = 'pending'`; workers claim jobs with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`. |
| `notifications` | id, hotel_id, user_id, type, payload, read_at |
| `notification_preferences` | (scope role/user, type, channel), enabled |
| `backup_runs` | id, kind, status, started_at, finished_at, file, size, sha256, verified_at, verify_result, error |
